## Package-native Combination Results

```{r results='asis'}
for (combo_name in names(snapshot$result$details)) {
  detail <- snapshot$result$details[[combo_name]]
  cat("### ", combo_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("#### ", detail$metric, " efficacy\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(detail$efficacy, digits = 3))
  cat("\n#### ", detail$metric, " synergy\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(as_display_table(detail$synergy), digits = 3))
  cat("\n#### ", detail$metric, " package figure\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("![%s package figure](%s)\n\n", detail$metric, knitr::image_uri(detail$figure)))
  cat("\n")
}
```
